title: Mounts: Slimy Saddle, Fuzzy Carrot, Honeyed Goggles and flying mounts
player_outcome: Mounts like Terraria: the Slimy Saddle (bouncy slime mount, from King Slime), Fuzzy Carrot (fast bunny), Honeyed Goggles (bee, flying, from Queen Bee), and hardmode flying mounts (e.g. Cosmic Car Key UFO); mounted movement, animations, mount slot use and a quick-mount key.
design: Core mount framework generalised from Gameplay/Mounts/Minecart.cs (data-driven MountDef: speed, jump, flight time, gravity, bounce), mount buff, mount slot (P2-05 EquippedMount; merge origin/claude/clever-goodall-kgex45 after its W3 push before starting), player controller integration in a new PlayerController.Mounts partial, mount models (Blender) and rider pose, drops added to boss loot (coordinate: add to data files with one entry per line).
Quality bar: what a AAA, realistic 3D Terraria made by Re-Logic would ship. Data-driven, performance-budgeted by graphics preset, Core logic tested, follows docs/overhaul/_BRIEF.md (LEAN MODE).
verification: movement.cmds mounts the Slimy Saddle and jumps higher
